§8Purpose and mechanism§r
Keep one §1107§r Singularity Controller in your inventory for this non-consuming check. The §1107§r is an EV assembler single-shot weapon, directly consuming Steam Entangled Singularities or Critical Steam Entangled Singularities as ammunition. It automatically reloads after a successful shot. Default controls: C changes normal/unstable mode, V changes ammunition, and R reloads; bindings can be changed in settings. In normal mode, left-click fires. In unstable mode, hold left-click for §15§r seconds and release after full charge; collision triggers the final blast immediately. Left-click again while a projectile is flying to begin a gesture that remotely detonates it after §10.5§r seconds. Attraction and explosions affect other players and allies, so keep teammates clear.

§cImportant precautions§r
The recipe uses titanium plates and long rods, an EV field generator, EV circuits, a steam entangled singularity, and an integrated circuit set to §14.§r Singularities serve both crafting and firing, so reserve them separately. Possession requires no firing. Before unstable shots or remote detonation, check players, allies, and equipment near the target. Automatic reload does not provide free ammunition.
